solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sexy devil lined up, we hear, in front of coach

indicators.note: in front of places the sound-alike piece before the vehicle
we hear tells the solver to go by sound, so the phrase for lined up is said rather than spelt

parts.note: lined up means waiting in a queue, in queue
a coach is a bus

explanation.surface: A tabloid-style tease: some seductive rogue is spotted standing in a line just ahead of a coach.
explanation.definitionFit: In folklore this is a male demon who seduces sleeping women, a sexy devil indeed.

clue.text: He's specially informed where the apples are, you might say

indicators.note: you might say means the phrase is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: apples are pressed to make cider, so they are in cider

explanation.surface: Someone well-briefed knows the location of the fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A person within an organisation with privileged information is specially informed.

clue.text: Derrick performed in church

indicators.note: in puts the performed word inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
ran means performed or operated

explanation.surface: A man named Derrick gave a performance in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Derrick' looks like a man's name, but is a lifting machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A derrick is a lifting apparatus with a jib, a kind of hoist.

clue.text: Left in rear, go astray

indicators.note: in puts the left letter inside the rear word

parts.note: a backside is one's rear

explanation.surface: Someone left behind at the back wanders off course.
explanation.definitionFit: To lapse back into bad ways is to stray morally.

clue.text: Possible sitter for one on the slide?

definitions.meaning: in cricket a ball hit high into the air may be a sitter, an easy catch
a person sliding downhill on snow

explanation.surface: Wonders who might sit for a child on the playground chute.
explanation.walkthrough: A sitter is cricket slang for an easy catch; a high-hit ball can be one.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket, a high mishit catch chance; on the slopes, a person who skis.

clue.text: Cover made by Welsh singer?

parts.note: a rapper is a performer who delivers lyrics, loosely a singer

explanation.surface: Asks whether some protective covering was produced by a vocalist from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: A packaging sheet or sleeve round an item is its cover, a simple synonym.

clue.text: Ruffled snakes escaped

parts.note: a path that snakes winds
wept means oozed or leaked out, as liquid escapes

explanation.surface: Agitated snakes got away.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair blown about by gusts is untidy, thus ruffled.

clue.text: She's a gem, but watch out!

definitions.meaning: a girl's name that is also fossil resin used as a gemstone
the yellow traffic light that warns drivers to take care

explanation.surface: A compliment about a lovely woman, followed by a warning.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's name and a yellow fossil resin jewel, and the cautionary traffic light colour.

clue.text: Drop illustration in laid-out recipe

indicators.note: in puts the illustration inside the shuffled recipe
laid-out means arranged anew, so the letters of recipe are reordered

parts.note: pic is short for picture, an illustration

explanation.surface: A cookbook layout has a picture dropped into its set-out recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'laid-out' rearranges the recipe letters to PRECIE, and the picture goes in near the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A cliff face with a sheer descent is a drop.

clue.text: Big-screen try-out offers opportunity to take the lead again

definitions.text: opportunity to take the lead again

indicators.note: offers means presents from within, so the letters lie in the words Big-screen try-out

explanation.surface: A cinema audition gives a performer another shot at being the star.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge a re-entry is a card that lets a player win a trick and regain the lead.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games such as bridge, a card enabling a hand to win the lead back.

clue.text: Pillar of church no saint — that's going around mistakenly

indicators.note: letters going around in error are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A church column is found to be no holy relic, and the rumour spreading is false.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an upright post or support bar, so a pillar by synonym.

clue.text: Note written in sombre vein

indicators.note: written in says the letters sit within the printed words sombre vein

explanation.surface: A message penned in a gloomy, serious mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical note worth two whole notes (semibreves), an old long note value.

clue.text: Grounds of desertion initially against the rules

indicators.note: against means next to, so the rules piece is set beside the first letter
initially picks the opening letter of desertion

parts.note: regs is short for regulations, i.e. rules

explanation.surface: Legal talk: the basis for a divorce on grounds of abandonment, claimed to break the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grounds' reads as legal justification, but here it is coffee sediment.
explanation.definitionFit: Grounds are the residue left at the bottom of a cup, the sediment of a drink.

clue.text: For self-control, practise engaging in relaxation

indicators.note: engaging in means going into, so the practise word is placed within the relaxation word

parts.note: rest is relaxation
to practise is to train

explanation.surface: Advice that a self-disciplined person should rehearse while unwinding.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding back one's impulses is restraint, a direct synonym of self-control.

clue.text: Send down unpractised Duchess for audience

indicators.note: for audience means the words are to be heard, not read

parts.note: unpractised is rusty, and Kate is the Duchess of Cambridge, giving rusty Kate

explanation.surface: A royal who has lost her touch is dismissed before facing the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Send down' is British university slang for suspending a student, which is what this verb means at Oxford and Cambridge.
explanation.definitionFit: At British universities, to send down a student is to suspend them temporarily, rusticating them.

clue.text: Substitute appears unexpectedly on right

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the first piece over the next
unexpectedly suggests the letters of appears turn up in a surprising order

explanation.surface: A football substitute suddenly shows up on the right wing.
explanation.definitionFit: A replacement component kept in reserve is a substitute part.

clue.text: 'Painting Hour' — it's an inflammatory experience

parts.note: painting is a form of art
it's expands to it is

explanation.surface: A painting title is described as provocative or incendiary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inflammatory' suggests rousing, but here it is medical: joint inflammation.
explanation.definitionFit: A disease causing painful swelling of the joints is literally an inflammation.

clue.text: For friendly relations, it's disaster ignoring circuit of French lake

indicators.note: ignoring says some letters are left out of the disaster word

parts.note: a calamity is a disaster

indicators.note: a circuit goes round and back, so the French lake word is turned to read backwards

parts.note: lac is French for lake

explanation.surface: Peace between nations hit by catastrophe, skipping a lap round a French lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circuit of' turns LAC into CAL, which 'ignoring' removes from the front of CALAMITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Amity is goodwill and friendship between people or countries, a synonym of friendly relations.

clue.text: Excited girl leaving energetically for dancing — a gas!

indicators.note: for dancing says the remaining letters move about into a new order
leaving means the girl letters depart from energetically

parts.note: an excited girl is stirred up, so her four letters come in a jumbled order, here in the order they sit in energetically

explanation.surface: A thrilled girl leaves the dance floor in high spirits, and what fun it was.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Excited' scrambles GIRL, whose letters 'leaving' takes out of ENERGETICALLY; 'for dancing' then rearranges ENEETCALY.
explanation.definitionFit: A colourless hydrocarbon used in welding torches is a flammable gas.

clue.text: Contract to entertain at the front? Contract …

indicators.note: the second contract means shorten, and at the front says the cut comes off the opening

parts.note: to please is to entertain or amuse

explanation.surface: A puzzled query about signing a deal to put on a show at the front line, then a repeated 'Contract' spilling into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'Contract' is a noun, the definition; the second is a verb meaning shorten, cutting the first letter off PLEASE.
explanation.definitionFit: A rental agreement for property is a type of contract, legally binding.

clue.text: Possibly sea lavender quietly removed pain

indicators.note: removed means the quiet letter is taken away

parts.note: plumbago, or leadwort, is a flowering plant related to sea lavender
P stands for piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: A sea lavender remedy, perhaps, silently eased someone's ache.
explanation.definitionFit: Lower back ache is a specific kind of pain.

clue.text: … deleted by mistake after note; here's another document

indicators.note: after places the jumbled word behind the note

parts.note: ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: by mistake says the letters of deleted are muddled

explanation.surface: Continuing from the previous clue, a contract wrongly erased after a memo, and here is yet another paper.
explanation.definitionFit: The legal paper proving ownership of land is a property document, following on from the previous contract.

clue.text: Weakened, lacking energy latterly, going nowhere

indicators.note: lacking means without, so a letter is taken out
latterly says it is the later occurrence that goes

parts.note: deadened means dulled or weakened
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone run down and recently out of steam is getting nowhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A street with no exit is a road going nowhere, figuratively a hopeless situation.

clue.text: Postal system's reported of instrument in confusion

indicators.note: reported means spoken aloud, so we take a word that sounds like the postal system's

parts.note: the postal system is the mail, so the possessive gives mail's

indicators.note: of here means only part of, so the latter half of the instrument word is dropped

parts.note: a trombone is a brass instrument

explanation.surface: A report that a delivery service's music gear has been thrown into disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the first half of TROMBONE is used; the blog reads 'of' as taking part of the instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent whirlpool, and figuratively a state of turmoil or chaos, hence confusion.

clue.text: Pickle, dear?

definitions.meaning: to pickle is to soak in brine or vinegar

explanation.surface: A fond address to someone in a pickle.
explanation.definitionFit: Soaking food in liquid is to marinate it; a price that is too high is excessive.

clue.text: Middling second income

parts.note: mean is average, middling

explanation.surface: An average second salary.
explanation.definitionFit: One's resources or money to live on is one's income.

clue.text: Grower heads for York urgently — Christmas cactus aboard

indicators.note: heads for picks the first letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A gardener rushes to York with a Christmas cactus on board.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a spiky-leaved plant, and any plant is something that grows, a cryptic sense of grower.

clue.text: Catholic service takes time and vocation, perhaps

parts.note: the RAF (Royal Air Force) is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A Catholic mass that lasts a while, and the calling to the priesthood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' suggests a church mass, but it is the armed service, the RAF.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled trade or occupation may be a vocation, an example.

clue.text: Ease up when cricketer gets sent into casualty?

indicators.note: gets sent into means placed inside, so the cricketer goes within the casualty letters

parts.note: A and E (accident and emergency) is the British hospital emergency department, informally called casualty
a bat is a batsman, a cricketer

explanation.surface: Suggests easing off when a cricket player ends up in the emergency ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease up is to lessen or subside, the same as to abate.

clue.text: Make music by electronic means? Endlessly tricky

parts.note: trad is traditional jazz, a style of music

indicators.note: tricky signals the remaining letters are rearranged
endlessly says the last letter of means is dropped

explanation.surface: Asks whether one can produce music electronically, before conceding it's hard, a point made incompletely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' looks like a verb but is the noun for a brand. 'Endlessly' leaves MEAN, and 'tricky' shuffles it to NAME.
explanation.definitionFit: A product's make is its brand, the registered name under which it is sold.

clue.text: Person with influence in court plugging 'Ring'

indicators.note: plugging means filling a gap, so the court letters go inside the ring letters

parts.note: ring gives the round letter O and also opus, Wagner's Ring being a great musical work

explanation.surface: An influential figure in a law court plugs a famous opera, or a ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring' works twice: as the round letter and as Wagner's operatic cycle, a major musical work. The blog's hint points to Paul the Octopus, the World Cup oracle.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, an organisation or person with tentacles everywhere and wide-reaching control.

clue.text: Aromatic compounds inspected after investigator turns and leaves

indicators.note: compounds means mixes, so the remaining letters are shuffled
leaves means departs, so those letters are taken out of inspected
turns says the investigator letters are flipped round

parts.note: a PI is a private investigator

explanation.surface: Fragrant chemicals are examined after a detective swivels and departs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' makes IP, whose letters 'leaves' takes out of INSPECTED, leaving NSECTED for 'compounds' to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Something scented has a pleasant smell, so it is aromatic, a straight synonym.
